content: The dissertation describes Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I as answering the charge of ṣūfīgarī: it comments on nine hadith against innovation and on sayings of Sufi masters to show Sufism is within the Sunna, and it attacks the accusers as mafiosos and hypocrites; the companion R. Iʿtiqādiyya, by contrast, shows him as a standard Ashʿari.
